name: La Musa
source:
You follow a young aspiring artist who’s lived his whole life out in the boonies since he could remember. Due to certain events, and certain things taken from you; you’re now sent on your way to a new university in the beautiful port city of La Musa, a bustling epicenter of style, art, history, and “new” friends you’ll be meeting along the way. 

On this new journey of life, you’ll question many things, your life, choices, and even reality itself. Will you see what's hidden behind the curtain, or will you just give in to the urges and find your “muse” by the end of the semester? 

[From [url=https://museproductionsteam.itch.io/la-musa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将跟随一位年轻的追梦艺术家。他从记事起便一直生活在偏远乡间。经历某些事件、失去某些东西之后，你启程前往La Musa这座美丽的港口城市，在那里就读一所新大学。这里汇聚时尚、艺术与历史，你也将在途中结识一些“新”朋友。

在人生这段新旅程中，你会质疑许多事情：自己的人生、做过的选择，甚至现实本身。你会看见帷幕后隐藏的真相，还是屈从于欲望，在学期结束前找到你的“缪斯”？

[来源：[url=https://museproductionsteam.itch.io/la-musa]Itch.io[/url]]
